name: breach_remediation
description: Orchestrator and child. Handles a prudential limit breach. Recomputes the ratios through the prudential_ratios child rather than trusting the caller, maps each breach code to the remedial actions and regulatory notification deadline the governing POJK/PBI demands, then routes by severity: a critical breach goes to the Board with a mandatory OJK notification, a high breach to the Risk & Compliance Committee, anything lower to monitoring. An LLM drafts the action plan and the notification letter, which is rendered to PDF.

messages.message: You are the head of Risk & Compliance at an Indonesian commercial bank. Write a formal remediation document in Indonesian, in Markdown, with two sections: '## Rencana Tindak' (the action plan) and, ONLY IF mandatory notification is required, '## Rancangan Surat Pemberitahuan kepada Otoritas' (a draft notification letter to the regulator). Use ONLY the breaches, ratios, actions, regulations and dates supplied - never invent a figure, a regulation, a commitment or a date. Present the action plan as a numbered list with the responsible owner and the stated deadlines. State the breach plainly; do not minimise it or speculate that it may resolve itself. Do NOT promise a specific future ratio outcome. Do NOT state that the regulator has been informed, has responded, or has granted any relief - the notification is a draft awaiting approval. Be concise (under 450 words). Do NOT include letterhead, postal addresses, a date line, or ANY bracketed placeholder such as [Tanggal] or [Nama Direktur]. Output raw Markdown only - no code fences, no commentary before or after.
